verdict: A quiet day: one real pipeline-relevant story (LTX's VFX tools), the rest is VFX breakdown PR, academic paper noise, and OpenAI corporate blogging with no production relevance.

stories.headline: LTX publishes technical detail on its VFX production tools
stories.body: Lightricks posted a blog detailing LTX's pipeline-facing tools, pitched for production use rather than consumer generation. Worth a read to see what integration points they're claiming (roto, restyle, consistency tools) before deciding if it's worth testing against existing comp workflows. Vendor-authored, so treat capability claims as unverified until tested.
stories.why: Could affect what's offered to clients as an AI-assisted restyle or roto option.

stories.headline: CG Channel rounds up new tools including a real-time AI renderer
stories.body: CG Channel's regular software roundup for late October includes texturing apps, a Blender animation add-on, and a real-time AI renderer, details thin in the summary. Worth scanning the full roundup for anything that lands as a plugin rather than a demo, but nothing here is confirmed as production-ready from the summary alone.
stories.why: Quick scan may surface a deployable tool; summary alone doesn't justify more.

stories.headline: Adobe ships Substance 3D Painter 12.2
stories.body: Adobe released Painter 12.2 with a new brush-based workflow for fixing texture-baking issues. Incremental point release, not a major feature addition, but relevant if Painter is part of the texturing pipeline and bake cleanup is a recurring pain point.
stories.why: Direct pipeline tool update, low effort to check if it fixes a known annoyance.
